page.layout: One column of dictionary entries, Hebrew headwords in large type at the left of each entry, with a line of Hebrew running head at the top and a catchword at the lower right. No text in the margins.

main_text.p: m.p. Selectissima, juxta quosdam, 1.Reg.4.23. Kimchi scribit, multos existimare, esse עופות המסורסים Aves castratas, id est, Capones. Id petitum ex Pandectis Talmudicis, Tractatu Bava mezia, fol.86. ubi scribitur, esse Gallos qui saginantur per coactionem, intruso illo cibo in os.
ברוש m. Abies, Jesa.41.19. Plural. נרושים Abietes, Jesa.14.8. Aff. ברושיו Abietum ejus, Jesa.37.24.

ברות m. Bruta, arbor, de qua Plinius lib.12.17. Cupresso similis, quomodo quidam interpretantur: Plural. ברותים Brutina, è brutis arboribus, Cypressina, Cant.1.17. Aben Esra scribit, juxta quosdam idem esse quod ברושים Abietes, Abiegna, commutatis ש & ת.
בריה[?] f. Vide supra in ברה.

בשל Elixari, Coqui, Maturescere; ut Joel.3. v.13. בשלו Elixant, Ezech.24.5. Pih. Praet. ובשלת Et coques, Deut.16.7. Partic. בית המבשלים Domus coquentium, Locus poparum, Ezech.46.24. Pyh. Praeter. בשלו Coctum fuerit, Levit.6.28. Partic. מבשל Coctum, Exod.12.9. Hiph. הבישילו Coxerunt; Maturarunt; sive Maturas protulerunt, Gen.40.10.
בשם m. Aroma odoratum, Exod.30.23. Aff. עם־בשמי Cum aromate meo, Cant.5. v.1. cujus forma absoluta esset בשם: Plural. בשמים Aromata, Exod.25.6. Aff. בשמיו Aromata ejus, Cant.4.16.
בשם Conculcare. Infinit. יען בושסכם Propter conculcare vos, Amos 5.11. idem quod בוס & בוסם. Nam ש est loco ם.

page.notes: Headwords are printed large and are dictionary entries, not divisions. Doubtful Hebrew readings: the first headword (ברברים?), the headword of the third-but-one entry (בריה), the Hebrew after "Propter" (בושסכם), and the vowel pointing throughout, which is hard to read at this scan size. "intruso" is printed with a long-s form and is given as "intruso". Catchword בשר is at the lower right. Stray marks at the left margin and bottom are not text.
